title: Frankie (TV series)
lead_cast: Eve MylesDean Lennox KellyDerek RiddellJulia FordCarla HenryLeila MimmackJemma Redgrave
premise_summary: Frankie is a British television drama series created by Lucy Gannon. The series stars Eve Myles as Frankie Maddox, a district nurse more emotionally involved with her job than her personal life. The series is both set and filmed in the English city of Bristol.
